unitTitle: Prepositions of Place - Was/Were - Had - Could
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 39-BET. Unit 9 — shahar xaritasi va was/were.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 1a (8 predlog), 1b (10 bino joyi), 2-mashq (12 bo'shliq), 3-mashq (9 bo'shliq) — jami 39 ta javob.

⚠ 1a — BESh PREDLOG, SAKKIZ BO'ShLIQ: uchtasi ikki martadan ishlatiladi (opposite, next to, between), 'on' va 'in front of' bir martadan. Jami 2+2+2+1+1 = 8.

⚠ XARITADAN O'QISh:
  OPPOSITE — ko'chaning NARIGI tomonida (restoran/pochta; kafe/park)
  NEXT TO — yonma-yon, bir tomonda (kinoteatr/supermarket; muzey/kasalxona)
  BETWEEN — ikkitasining ORASIDA (mehmonxona: park va garaj orasida; maktab: bank va militsiya orasida)
  IN FRONT OF — oldida (avtobus bekati militsiya binosi oldida)
  ON the corner of — ikki ko'cha BURChAGIDA (garaj: Queen St va Victoria St)

⚠ 2-MAShQ — 'WAS' yoki 'WERE': 'I', 'he', 'she', 'it' va 'the match' → WAS; 'you', 'we', 'they' → WERE.
  ⚠ Dialogda 'you' TO'RT marta uchraydi va har safar 'were' oladi — hatto bitta odamga murojaat qilganda ham.

⚠ 3-MAShQ — 'THERE WAS' yoki 'THERE WERE': keyingi ot BIRLIKDA bo'lsa 'was', KO'PLIKDA bo'lsa 'were'.
  'There WEREN'T any department storeS' (ko'plik)
  'WAS there a park?' (birlik)
  'There WERE a lot of people' (ko'plik)
  ⚠ Ya'ni 'there' o'zi hech narsani ko'rsatmaydi — undan KEYINGI otga qarang.

exercises.explanationUz:
XARITA TUZILISHI:

  QUEEN STREET dan SHIMOLDA (yuqorida):

  ┌────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────┐
  │ HOSPITAL   │ BANK         │ CAFÉ         │ PARK     │
  ├────────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┼──────────┤
  │ MUSEUM     │ SCHOOL       │ DEPARTMENT   │ HOTEL    │
  │            │              │ STORE        │          │
  ├────────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┼──────────┤
  │ RESTAURANT │ POLICE       │ SPORTS       │ GARAGE   │
  │            │ STATION      │ CENTRE       │          │
  │            │ (+ BUS STOP  │              │          │
  │            │   oldida)    │              │          │
  └────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────┘
        ↑ MAIN STREET              ↑ VICTORIA STREET

  ══════════════ QUEEN STREET ══════════════════════════

  QUEEN STREET dan JANUBDA (pastda):
  ┌──────┬────────────┬────────┬────────┬──────────┐
  │ POST │ SUPER-     │ CINEMA │ FIRE   │ RAILWAY  │
  │OFFICE│ MARKET     │        │STATION │ STATION  │
  └──────┴────────────┴────────┴────────┴──────────┘

UCH KO'CHA:
  MAIN STREET     — tik, chapda
  VICTORIA STREET — tik, o'ngda
  QUEEN STREET    — yotiq, o'rtada

PREDLOG TANLASH QOIDASI:
  ko'cha AJRATMAYDI, yonma-yon   → next to
  ko'cha AJRATADI, yuzma-yuz     → opposite
  ikkitasining o'rtasida         → between
  old tomonida                   → in front of
  ikki ko'cha kesishmasi         → on the corner of

points.en: MAIN STREET, VICTORIA STREET, QUEEN STREET
points.noteUz:
Main va Victoria — TIK;  Queen — YOTIQ.
Predlog tanlashda shu ko'chalar hal qiladi.
Ikkinchi ustun bilan bir blokda, yonma-yon.

points.en: post office – supermarket – cinema – fire station – railway station

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the diagram, then complete the sentences with prepositions from the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Xaritaga qarang, so'ng gaplarni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi predloglar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in front of, opposite, next to, on, between

Besh predlog, sakkiz gap — demak ba'zilari
BIR NECHA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  next to  → 2 marta
  opposite → 2 marta
  between  → 2 marta
  in front of → 1 marta
  on       → 1 marta

items.textEn: 1  The restaurant is ............ the post office.
items.whyUz:
Restoran Queen Street dan SHIMOLDA,
pochta esa JANUBDA → ko'cha ajratadi → OPPOSITE.

items.hintUz: Ikkalasi ham Queen Street ostida, yonma-yon
items.whyUz:
Ikkalasi BIR qatorda, yonma-yon — ko'cha ajratmaydi →
NEXT TO.
1-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ko'cha bor edi.

items.textEn: 3  The garage is ............ the corner of Queen St and Victoria St.
items.whyUz:
'ON the corner of X and Y' — o'zgarmas ibora.
Garaj ikki ko'cha kesishgan joyda.

Kafe Victoria Street ning G'ARBIDA,
bog' esa SHARQIDA → OPPOSITE.
Ikkalasi ham yuqori qatorda.

items.textEn: 5  The bus stop is ............ the police station.
items.whyUz:
Xaritada avtobus bekati militsiya bo'limi binosining
OLDIDA turibdi → IN FRONT OF.
Aksi: behind.

items.textEn: 6  The hotel is ............ the park and the garage.
items.whyUz:
O'ng ustun: PARK → HOTEL → GARAGE.
Mehmonxona ikkisining O'RTASIDA → BETWEEN.
'between A AND B' — 'and' shart.

Chap ustun: HOSPITAL → MUSEUM → RESTAURANT.
Bir blokda, ko'cha ajratmaydi → NEXT TO.

items.textEn: 8  The school is ............ the bank and the police station.
items.whyUz:
Ikkinchi ustun: BANK → SCHOOL → POLICE STATION.
Maktab o'rtada → BETWEEN.

exercises.instructionEn: Where is: the hospital? the museum? the post office? the bank? the school? the supermarket? the department store? the fire station? the park? the railway station?
exercises.instructionUz: Qayerda: kasalxona? muzey? pochta? bank? maktab? supermarket? univermag? o't o'chirish bo'limi? bog'? temiryo'l bekati?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOB QOLIPI:
  It's next to / opposite / between ... .

Ko'p joy uchun bir nechta to'g'ri javob bo'lishi mumkin —
qaysi qo'shni haqida gapirishingizga bog'liq.
Quyida eng aniq javoblar berilgan.

ESLATMA:
  bir blokda, ko'chasiz → next to
  ko'cha ajratgan       → opposite
  ikkitasining o'rtasida → between

items.answer: It's next to the museum. It's opposite the bank.
items.whyUz:
Muzey bilan bir blokda, yonma-yon → next to.
Main Street narigi tomonida BANK → opposite.

items.answer: It's between the hospital and the restaurant. It's opposite the school.
items.whyUz:
Kasalxona va restoran O'RTASIDA → between.
Main Street narigi tomonida SCHOOL → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the supermarket. It's opposite the restaurant.
items.whyUz:
Supermarket yonida → next to.
Queen Street narigi tomonida RESTAURANT → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the café. It's opposite the hospital.
items.whyUz:
Kafe bilan yonma-yon (bir blokda) → next to.
Main Street narigi tomonida HOSPITAL → opposite.

items.answer: It's between the bank and the police station. It's opposite the museum.
items.whyUz:
1a-mashqning 8-bandi bilan bir xil javob.
Main Street narigi tomonida MUSEUM → opposite.

items.answer: It's between the post office and the cinema.
items.whyUz:
Qator: POST OFFICE | SUPERMARKET | CINEMA | FIRE STATION |
RAILWAY STATION.
Supermarket pochta va kinoteatr orasida → between.

items.answer: It's between the café and the sports centre. It's next to the school.
items.whyUz:
Uchinchi ustun: CAFÉ → DEPARTMENT STORE → SPORTS CENTRE.
O'rtada → between. Maktab bilan yonma-yon → next to.

items.answer: It's between the cinema and the railway station.
items.whyUz: Kinoteatr va temiryo'l bekati orasida → between.

items.answer: It's next to the hotel. It's opposite the café.
items.whyUz:
Mehmonxona bilan bir blokda → next to.
Victoria Street narigi tomonida CAFÉ → opposite
(1a-mashqning 4-bandi).

items.answer: It's next to the fire station. It's opposite the garage.
items.whyUz:
O't o'chirish bo'limi yonida → next to.
Queen Street narigi tomonida GARAGE → opposite.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in were, was or wasn't.
exercises.instructionUz: were, was yoki wasn't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WERE you at the cinema last night?
  B: No, I WASN'T. I WAS at the football match.
  A: Who WERE you with?
  B: I WAS with John.
  A: How WAS the match?
  B: It WAS very exciting! My favourite team won!
     Where WERE you?
  A: I WAS at my parents' house.
  B: WERE you with your sister?
  A: No, I WASN'T. She WAS at work.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun kinoteatrda midingiz?
  B: Yo'q, emasdim. Futbol o'yinida edim.
  A: Kim bilan eding?
  B: Jon bilan edim.
  A: O'yin qanday edi?
  B: Juda qiziqarli edi! Sevimli jamoam yutdi!
     Sen qayerda eding?
  A: Ota-onamning uyida edim.
  B: Singling bilan midingiz?
  A: Yo'q, emasdim. U ishda edi.

DIQQAT — RO'YXATDA 'weren't' YO'Q:
  Faqat were, was, wasn't berilgan.
  Demak hamma inkor BIRLIK ega bilan keladi.

QOIDA:
  I, he, she, it → was / wasn't
  you, we, they  → were

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  exciting = qiziqarli, hayajonli
  a team   = jamoa
  to win (won) = yutmoq (yutdi)
  my parents' house = ota-onamning uyi

lines.textEn: 1) ............ you at the cinema last night?
lines.whyUz:
'you' → WERE (birlik ma'noda ham).
So'roq gapda fe'l boshda.

'you' → WERE.
'Who were you with?' — 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

'the match' BIRLIK → WAS.
'How was ...?' = ... qanday edi?

'it' → WAS.
'exciting' = qiziqarli, hayajonli.
Undov belgisi ijobiy bahoni kuchaytiradi.

'I' → WAS.
DIQQAT: 'parents'' — ko'plik otda egalik apostrofi
's' dan KEYIN qo'yiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in was, wasn't, were or weren't.
exercises.instructionUz: was, wasn't, were yoki weren't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TANLASH UCHUN IKKI SAVOL:

  1) Ega BIRLIKmi yoki KO'PLIKmi?
       birlik  → was / wasn't
       ko'plik → were / weren't
       ('you' DOIM ko'plik shakli oladi)

  2) TASDIQmi yoki INKORmi?
       'any' bo'lsa — deyarli DOIM inkor
       'No, ...' javobi — inkor

DIQQAT — 'THERE WAS' va 'THERE WERE':
  Keyingi ot BIRLIK  → there was
     Was there A PARK here?
  Keyingi ot KO'PLIK → there were
     There weren't any DEPARTMENT STORES.

items.textEn: 1  There ............ any department stores here twenty years ago.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'department stores' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.
'twenty years ago' → o'tgan zamon.

'a park' BIRLIK → WAS.
So'roq gapda 'Was' boshda: 'Was there ...?'
'then' = o'shanda.

Savol 'Was there ...?' → javob 'No, there WASN'T.'
Savoldagi shakl javobda takrorlanadi.

'your favourite toys' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'a toy' = o'yinchoq.

'you' → DOIM WERE (birlik ma'noda ham).
'when you were a child' = bola bo'lganingda.
DIQQAT: 'a child' birlik bo'lsa ham, EGA 'you' —
shuning uchun WERE.

items.textEn: 4  There ............ any cars here forty years ago.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'cars' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.
1-band bilan bir xil tuzilish.

items.textEn: 5  Is Julia ill? She ............ at school today.
items.whyUz:
'ill' = kasal → maktabda BO'LMAGAN → INKOR.
'She' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
Mantiq: kasal bo'lgani uchun maktabga kelmagan.

items.textEn: 6  There ............ a lot of people at the party last night.
items.whyUz:
'people' — KO'PLIK ot ('person' ning ko'pligi) → WERE.
'any' yo'q → TASDIQ.
'a lot of people' = ko'p odam.

'you' → WERE.
'yesterday' = kecha → o'tgan zamon.

wordFormation.introUz: 39-bet — xaritadagi joylar va was/were tanlash mezonlari.

groups.explanationUz: Ko'pchiligi qo'shma ot yoki ot + ot birikmasi.

groups.ruleUz: WAS yoki WERE — qaror qabul qilish
groups.explanationUz: Faqat EGAGA qaraladi, keyingi otga emas.
'any' ko'rsangiz, deyarli doim inkor yoki so'roq.

patterns.formula: The X is NEXT TO / OPPOSITE / BETWEEN ... the Y.
patterns.exampleEn: The museum is next to the hospital. The restaurant is opposite the post office.
patterns.exampleUz: Muzey kasalxona yonida. Restoran pochta ro'parasida.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratsa — opposite;  ajratmasa — next to.

patterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... St AND ... St.
patterns.exampleEn: The garage is on the corner of Queen St and Victoria St.
patterns.exampleUz: Garaj Queen va Victoria ko'chalari burchagida.

patterns.exampleEn: Were you at the cinema last night? — No, I wasn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun kinoteatrda midingiz? — Yo'q, emasdim.
patterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda savoldagi fe'l shakli takrorlanadi.

patterns.exampleEn: There weren't any cars here forty years ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Qirq yil oldin bu yerda mashina yo'q edi.
patterns.explanationUz: Tartib: There + fe'l + ot + JOY + VAQT.

patterns.formula: What were your favourite ...s when you were a child?
patterns.exampleEn: What were your favourite toys when you were a child?
patterns.exampleUz: Bola bo'lganingda sevimli o'yinchoqlaring nima edi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala fe'l ham o'tgan zamonda.
'you' → DOIM were.
